ayahs.en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
ayahs.e2: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come

ayahs.en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer
ayahs.e2: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—

ayahs.en: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent
ayahs.e2: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent

ayahs.ar: تَعۡرُجُ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيۡهِ فِي يَوۡمࣲ كَانَ مِقۡدَارُهُۥ خَمۡسِينَ أَلۡفَ سَنَةࣲ‏
ayahs.en: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years
ayahs.e2: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length
ayahs.tr: Ta'rujul malaaa'ikatu war Roohu ilaihi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah

ayahs.en: So be patient with gracious patience
ayahs.e2: So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience

ayahs.en: Indeed, they see it [as] distant
ayahs.e2: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible

ayahs.en: But We see it [as] near
ayahs.e2: but We see it as inevitable

ayahs.en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil
ayahs.e2: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass

ayahs.en: And the mountains will be like wool
ayahs.e2: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool

ayahs.en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend
ayahs.e2: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends

ayahs.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمۡۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُ لَوۡ يَفۡتَدِي مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمِئِذِۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.e2: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children
ayahs.tr: Yubassaroonahum; ya waddul mujrimu law yaftadee min 'azaabi yawma'izim bibaneeh

ayahs.en: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.e2: their spouses, their siblings

ayahs.en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.e2: their clan that sheltered them

ayahs.ar: وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعࣰ ا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him
ayahs.e2: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves
ayahs.tr: Wa man fil ardi jamee'an summa yunjeeh

ayahs.en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell]
ayahs.e2: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame

ayahs.en: A remover of exteriors
ayahs.e2: ripping off scalps

ayahs.en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.e2: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺

ayahs.en: And collected [wealth] and hoarded
ayahs.e2: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺

ayahs.en: Indeed, mankind was created anxious
ayahs.e2: Indeed, humankind was created impatient

ayahs.en: When evil touches him, impatient
ayahs.e2: distressed when touched with evil

ayahs.en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it]
ayahs.e2: and withholding when touched with good—

ayahs.en: Except the observers of prayer
ayahs.e2: except those who pray

ayahs.en: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.e2: consistently performing their prayers

ayahs.en: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ayahs.e2: and who give the rightful share of their wealth

ayahs.en: For the petitioner and the deprived
ayahs.e2: to the beggar and the poor

ayahs.en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment

ayahs.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
ayahs.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord
ayahs.e2: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—

ayahs.en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe
ayahs.e2: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—

ayahs.en: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.e2: and those who guard their chastity

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزۡوَٰجِهِمۡ أَوۡ مَا مَلَكَتۡ أَيۡمَٰنُهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ غَيۡرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed
ayahs.e2: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame
ayahs.tr: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fainnahum ghairu maloomeen

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبۡتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡعَادُونَ
ayahs.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors
ayahs.e2: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
ayahs.tr: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

ayahs.en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.e2: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants
ayahs.tr: Wallazeena hum li amaa naatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

ayahs.en: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.e2: and who are honest in their testimony

ayahs.en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer
ayahs.e2: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

ayahs.en: They will be in gardens, honored
ayahs.e2: These will be in Gardens, held in honour

ayahs.en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad]
ayahs.e2: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺
ayahs.tr: Famaa lil lazeena kafaroo qibalaka muhti'een

ayahs.en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups
ayahs.e2: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺

ayahs.ar: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيࣲٕ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure
ayahs.e2: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss
ayahs.tr: Ayatma'u kullum ri'im minhum anyyudkhala jannata Na'eem

ayahs.en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know
ayahs.e2: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from
ayahs.tr: Kallaaa innaa khalaq nahum mimmaa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: فَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
ayahs.e2: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable
ayahs.tr: Falaaa uqsimu bi Rabbil mashaariqi wal maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهُمۡ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَسۡبُوقِينَ
ayahs.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone
ayahs.e2: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺
ayahs.tr: Alaaa an nubaddila khairam minhum wa maa Nahnu bimasbooqeen

ayahs.ar: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلۡعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised
ayahs.e2: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—
ayahs.tr: Fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yaw mahumul lazee yoo'adoon

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ سِرَاعࣰ ا كَأَنَّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ نُصُبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening
ayahs.e2: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺
ayahs.tr: Yawma yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi siraa'an ka anna hum ilaa nusubiny yoofidoon

ayahs.ar: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised
ayahs.e2: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of
ayahs.tr: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillah; zaalikal yawmul lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon
